jobs.title: Senior Director, Optical Packaging Technology (OPT) Development
jobs.description:
Responsible for profitability and growth of a specific business line.

Typically Performs One Or More Of The Following In Capacity Of Either An Individual Contributor (as Directed And/or Independently), Or As a Manager

Responsible for the profitability and growth of the entire or part of global business line
Develops and implements programs & strategies that will successfully promote the organization's mission & meet financial objectives.
Identifies target customers, maintains and strengthens external relationships including customers & other external authorities
Accountable for and drives commitment; to compliance with all internal policies and legal regulations in every area of the organizations daily activity, including development of short and long-term plans, policies, and guidelines
Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs
Work and collaborate other projects and/or assignments as needed.

See description for career level for general proficiency levels pertaining to Job Complexity, Accountability, Relationship Focus, and Knowledge, Skills & Abilities. These proficiency levels apply to all career levels. Some requirements may vary locally.

About The Role

GlobalFoundries is hiring an Optical Packaging Technology (OPT) Development leader within the Integrated Optics (IO) organization and is seeking a Senior Director. A successful candidate will define an organizational structure, recruit and develop the leadership team, and set the technical and operational strategy across advanced packaging, optics, and product engineering for GF's Integrated Optics portfolio. The role is based in Burlington, VT and will partner within a matrixed global organization.

Key Responsibilities

Own the technical strategy and roadmap for Optical Packaging Technology (OPT) Development, spanning advanced packaging, optics, and product engineering.
Lead Package Design & Assembly architecture decisions for optical/photonic modules, including substrate, interposer, and co-packaging approaches.
Drive Yield Enhancement programs, using statistical process control and root-cause analysis to close yield gaps in packaging and assembly.
Own Packaging Qualification & Reliability strategy, including qualification test plans, stress testing, and reliability modeling to meet customer and industry standards.
Direct the Optics function's technical roadmap, covering optics/laser solutions, optical alignment and fiber attach processes, and co-packaged/advanced optics integration architectures.
Guide Product Engineering technical investigations, including returns analysis and failure analysis (FA) methodology, to close the loop between field issues and process/design changes.
Partner with Test engineering to co-develop test strategy, coverage, and qualification requirements aligned to package and optical architecture.
Set technical requirements and provide engineering oversight for external assembly/test partners, reviewing process capability, yield, and quality data.
Evaluate and down-select advanced packaging and optical integration technologies (e.g., co-packaged optics, fiber attach methods, EIC/PIC integration schemes) for technology roadmaps.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Silicon Products Development on EIC/PIC and optical engine architecture to ensure package-silicon co-design alignment.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related field required; advanced degree (MS/PhD) strongly preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience in semiconductor or photonics packaging, with significant time in advanced packaging and/or optical/photonic integration.
Proven track record building or scaling a technical organization, including hiring and developing senior technical leaders.
Deep technical expertise in advanced packaging (assembly, package design, yield, qualification/reliability) and/or optical packaging (fiber attach, co-packaged optics).
Experience managing outsourced assembly and test (OSAT) partner relationships.
Strong executive presence and experience partnering with senior leadership, customers, and cross-site global teams.
Demonstrated ability to operate in a matrixed, multi-site global organization (US, Egypt, India, Singapore, Vermont).
Excellent communication, organizational design, and change-leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Comfortable operating in a matrixed, multicultural environment.
Strong alignment with values of integrity, innovation, and operational excellence.
Ability to lead through influence and build trust across diverse teams.

Other Responsibilities

Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs

Expected Salary Range

$198,000.00 - $333,000.00

The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location.

If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case-by-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address.

jobs.title: Senior Director, R&D AI & Technology Portfolio
jobs.description:
We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programmes, pension plan membership, and shares and savings programme.

We embrace modern work practises; our Performance with Choice programme offers a hybrid working model, empowering you to find the optimal balance between remote and in-office work.

Discover more about our company wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage Life at GSK | GSK

Senior Director, R&D AI & Technology Portfolio

As the Senior Director, R&D AI & Technology Portfolio, you will provide strategic oversight, portfolio analytics and decision support for GSK's R&D AI and technology investments. Working closely with the SVP, R&D Technology Transformation and Operations, you will connect insights across priority programmes, strengthen transparency and value assurance, and help senior leaders make informed investment choices. This is a highly influential senior individual contributor role, operating across R&D through collaboration and influence rather than direct ownership of programme delivery.

This senior role is based in the United States. It is hybrid, combining regular on-site collaboration with remote work flexibility. You will need to be available for on-site meetings as required.

For candidates seeking to be located at our Stevenage site, this role will temporarily be based at Stevenage. However, the Company plans to relocate its offices to Cambridge, UK. The location of this role will therefore subsequently change to Cambridge, UK in accordance with timelines to be set by the Company. The relocation is currently proposed to take effect by early 2029.

This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

Shape the portfolio view for priority AI and technology investments across the R&D value chain, aligned with scientific and business priorities.
Support investment prioritisation by assessing delivery progress, expected value, strategic alignment, risks and cross-programme dependencies.
Lead the Technology Investment Board secretariat, including agenda development, decision-ready content and preparation of programme teams.
Provide independent analysis and recommendations to the SVP, R&D Technology Transformation and Operations and other senior leaders.
Evaluate strategic choices, including whether capabilities should be built internally, bought, developed with partners or explored through acquisition.
Build effective relationships across R&D, Finance and programme teams to create transparency and turn cross-functional input into action.

In this role you will

Own portfolio analytics and reporting, creating a credible view of programme status, investment, benefits, risks and delivery confidence.
Identify common capabilities, dependencies and risks across the portfolio, and recommend actions that improve collective value and delivery.
Lead the content and operating cadence for Technology Investment Board meetings, ensuring topics and submissions are ready for senior decisions.
Work with programme teams to test assumptions, challenge optimistic reporting constructively and improve the quality and consistency of evidence.
Track the external AI and technology ecosystem, peers and potential partners, translating insights into implications for portfolio strategy.
Mobilise ambiguous, cross-functional work without formal authority, establishing governance, securing outputs and communicating clear recommendations.

Why you?

Basic Qualifications & Skills:

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent experience in strategy, portfolio management, life sciences, technology or transformation.
Minimum 10 years of experience providing strategic oversight or analysis across a complex portfolio of programmes, investments or transformation initiatives.
Understanding of pharmaceutical R&D and the ability to work credibly across different stages of the R&D value chain.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to turn complex evidence into executive-level recommendations.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver outcomes through matrix teams without relying on formal authority.
Experience establishing governance, mobilising ambiguous cross-functional work and driving tangible outputs with limited supervision.

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply:

Background in management consulting, R&D strategy, corporate strategy, business development or enterprise transformation.
Experience with AI or technology strategy, portfolio management, or assessing external technology and competitive developments.
Experience supporting build, buy, partner or acquisition assessments involving technology capabilities or vendors.
Experience preparing content for an investment board, executive committee or similar senior governance forum.
Experience partnering with Finance on investment performance, portfolio metrics, benefits tracking or value assurance.
Confidence using AI-enabled productivity and analytical tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to improve insight and efficiency.

What We Value

We act with transparency, respect and accountability. We look for people who are curious, practical and focused on outcomes that help patients. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to inclusion.

Ready to apply?

If you are motivated to shape strategic decisions across a high-impact R&D AI and technology portfolio, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

Closing Date for Applications – 27th September 2026

Please take a copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available post closure of the advert.

When applying for this role, please use the ‘cover letter’ of the online application or your CV to describe how you meet the competencies for this role, as outlined in the job requirements above. The information that you have provided in your cover letter and CV will be used to assess your application.

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

Find out more:

Our approach to R&D

Skills

AI Ops, Change Management, Communication, Consulting, Cross-Departmental Collaboration, Decision Making, Financial Acumen, Innovation, Investment Management, Leadership, Portfolio Management, Portfolio Management Strategies, Project Management, Project Management Governance, Risk Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Strategic Leadership, Visionary Thinking

Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

If you require an accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at GSK, please contact the appropriate Recruitment Staff by emailing us at - usrecruitment.adjustments@gsk.com.

GSK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), military service or any basis prohibited under federal, state or local law.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please note that if you are a US Licensed Healthcare Professional or Healthcare Professional as defined by the laws of the state issuing your license, GSK may be required to capture and report expenses GSK incurs, on your behalf, in the event you are afforded an interview for employment. This capture of applicable transfers of value is necessary to ensure GSK’s compliance to all federal and state US Transparency requirements. For more information, please visit the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) website at https://openpaymentsdata.cms.gov/

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Engineering & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Allego is a rapidly growing SaaS technology company in the Boston area and creator of the market-leading Revenue Enablement Platform. Our technology helps Go-To-Market teams build the skills and access the knowledge they need to succeed in every selling situation.

Allego is the only revenue enablement platform to be named a Leader in both the Forrester Wave™ and the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Enablement Platforms.

Not only are we growing quickly, but we’ve also been recognized as a top place to work by The Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe, and Inc. Magazine. In addition, Selling Power named Allego one of the 50 Best Companies to Sell For in both 2025 and 2026.

What You'll Do At Allego

We're building a modern, scalable go-to-market engine, and this role will be instrumental in shaping how we generate pipeline, accelerate revenue, and operate at scale.

As our Marketing Engineering & Operations leader, you will own the systems, processes, data, and automation that power our revenue engine. You will partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, SDR, and Sales teams to ensure our GTM motion is efficient, measurable, and built for growth.

This is not a traditional marketing operations role focused solely on campaign execution or platform administration. We're looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, operational excellence, systems expertise, and AI-driven innovation to create a world-class revenue engine.

You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building scalable processes from the ground up, and are energized by using technology and automation to solve complex business challenges.

Core Responsibilities

GTM Systems & Infrastructure

Own HubSpot as the primary marketing platform, including architecture, workflows, integrations, lifecycle management, and data governance.
Partner closely with RevOps and Salesforce teams to ensure seamless data flow and alignment across the revenue funnel.
Establish scalable standards for campaign setup, data structure, naming conventions, lifecycle stages, and operational governance.
Drive ongoing optimization of the GTM technology stack to improve efficiency, visibility, and performance.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of marketing and funnel data.

Demand Generation Operations

Own the operational framework supporting demand generation programs from lead capture through qualification, routing, nurture, and handoff.
Optimize forms, landing pages, conversion paths, enrichment processes, and routing logic to maximize conversion and data quality.
Build and scale email and nurture infrastructure that supports personalized, journey-based engagement.
Develop repeatable QA processes, documentation, and governance standards that enable flawless campaign execution.
Establish clear intake, prioritization, and project management processes for marketing operations initiatives.

Lead Management & Funnel Optimization

Design and evolve a sophisticated lead management framework that combines:
ICP fit and account qualification
Firmographic and technographic data
Behavioral engagement signals
Third-party intent data

Own lead routing, assignment logic, and SLA management across the funnel.
Continuously refine scoring and qualification models based on conversion, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
Identify bottlenecks, friction points, and revenue leakage opportunities and implement solutions to improve funnel performance.
Partner with SDR and Sales leaders to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline creation.

SDR & Inbound Revenue Operations

Own the operational infrastructure supporting inbound lead management and SDR workflows.
Create feedback loops between Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams to continuously improve lead quality and conversion performance.
Monitor and optimize key metrics including speed-to-lead, contact rates, qualification rates, and pipeline generation.
Leverage automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, responsiveness, and revenue outcomes.
Ensure alignment across teams through shared processes, reporting, and accountability.

Reporting, Attribution & Revenue Insights

Partner with RevOps to develop and evolve attribution models that accurately measure marketing impact.
Build and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline creation, funnel health, campaign performance, and revenue contribution.
Monitor lifecycle conversion rates and proactively identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities.
Deliver actionable insights that help leadership make informed investment and growth decisions.
Establish a culture of data-driven decision making across the GTM organization.

Process Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and maintain operational frameworks, governance standards, SLAs, and prioritization processes.
Lead regular reviews of funnel performance, operational effectiveness, and strategic initiatives.
Serve as a trusted partner to Marketing, Sales, SDR, and RevOps leaders.
Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable processes, systems, and solutions.
Drive alignment across teams to ensure a consistent and efficient customer journey.

AI & Automation Strategy

Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
Implement AI-driven workflows that enhance data quality, campaign execution, lead management, reporting, and team productivity.
Evaluate emerging technologies and scale successful use cases across the GTM organization.
Introduce intelligent automation and prompt-driven workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate execution.
Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for AI adoption within GTM Operations.

Experience You'll Bring To Allego

10+ years in marketing operations, with a track record that spans multiple stages of company growth. Has owned the full ops function — not just administered tools — at a B2B SaaS company. Has built or inherited a broken stack and made it work. Understands what $50M ARR looks like operationally and what $100M needs to look like.

Skills & Qualifications

Deep HubSpot expertise as primary admin — architecture, workflows, lifecycle management, and integration design
Strong Salesforce fluency — can work directly with RevOps or serve as a de facto admin; understands the Marketing↔CRM data layer
Has built multi-touch attribution models and MQL scoring frameworks from scratch, and iterated on them using real conversion data; experience incorporating ICP fit and intent signals (G2, Bombora, 6sense, or equivalent) into lead scoring models
Experienced with AI-powered sales engagement platforms — Nooks AI or comparable inbound SDR tools; understands how inbound lead routing logic works and how to build the feedback loop between Marketing and SDR
Comfortable with BI and reporting tools — can build executive-facing dashboards, not just pull data
Genuine curiosity and working knowledge of AI tools and automation — actively explores how AI can accelerate ops workflows, reduce manual work, and improve data quality; not waiting to be told what to adopt
Visionary orientation — can see where the function needs to be in 18 months and reverse-engineer the roadmap to get there
Has navigated cross-functional ownership disputes between Marketing, RevOps, and Sales Ops; knows how to establish and hold a RACI

Compensation & Benefits

$135,000 - $160,000 base + 10% variable bonus target + equity

Benefits

Allego offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits program that enables employees to choose the benefits that best fit their needs and the needs of their families. Full time new hires are eligible for most benefits on the first day of employment:

Medical/dental/vision
Unlimited vacation
Paid parental leave
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
401(k) with matching
Short & long term disability, AD&D, life insurance
This position is posted as hybrid, however remote candidates may be considered.*

Operating Principles

Allego’s Operating Principles are at the heart of our business. They are the fabric of our culture and central to our approach to work, our customers and each other. Interested in learning more? Read more here!

Allego collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European Job Applicant see the privacy notice for further details.

Allego does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits. It is unlawful in MA to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
About The Company

Our client is a leading asset manager within the digital assets industry that offers a variety of public and private investment products. The Head of Engineering will be responsible for leading the team in adopting emerging technologies and provide recommendations when to purchase SaaS solutions or build proprietary solutions. This role reports into the Head of Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

Oversee engineering CI/CD processes, manage the technology stack, oversee technical documentation process, and drive adoption of new engineering practices to ensure continuous improvement
Advocate for a long-term tech roadmap that enhances scalability, reduces operational burden, and prioritizes reducing tech debt
Work with lead architect to build systems to find balance between robustness of capability and design simplicity
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, operations, and security) and other engineers and technologists to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables
Drive technical discussions, tech document reviews, and code assessments to ensure well-engineered, high-quality solutions
Align and influence the roadmap of enterprise data applications, driving execution of strategic initiatives
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies
Lead recruitment on new engineers
Oversee engineering and offshore quality assurance teams

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field
10-12 years in software engineering including experience in system design, architecture, and scaling
Experience managing tech managers, tech leads, and tenured senior individual contributors
Experience with .NET , AWS, IaaC, distributed data frameworks, Python, and data processing tools such as PL/SQL, Microsoft SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks
Hands-on experience with DevOps and continuous integration tools
Strong Agile proficiency with practical application to deliver incremental, high-quality solutions
Experience working in a regulated industry and/or financial services or fintech
Strong interpersonal skills, adept at building collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders

Salary Range

$225,000-$250,000

new_jobs.title: Senior Marketing Engineering & Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
Allego is a rapidly growing SaaS technology company in the Boston area and creator of the market-leading Revenue Enablement Platform. Our technology helps Go-To-Market teams build the skills and access the knowledge they need to succeed in every selling situation.

Allego is the only revenue enablement platform to be named a Leader in both the Forrester Wave™ and the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Enablement Platforms.

Not only are we growing quickly, but we’ve also been recognized as a top place to work by The Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe, and Inc. Magazine. In addition, Selling Power named Allego one of the 50 Best Companies to Sell For in both 2025 and 2026.

What You'll Do At Allego

We're building a modern, scalable go-to-market engine, and this role will be instrumental in shaping how we generate pipeline, accelerate revenue, and operate at scale.

As our Marketing Engineering & Operations leader, you will own the systems, processes, data, and automation that power our revenue engine. You will partner closely with Marketing, RevOps, SDR, and Sales teams to ensure our GTM motion is efficient, measurable, and built for growth.

This is not a traditional marketing operations role focused solely on campaign execution or platform administration. We're looking for someone who can combine strategic thinking, operational excellence, systems expertise, and AI-driven innovation to create a world-class revenue engine.

You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building scalable processes from the ground up, and are energized by using technology and automation to solve complex business challenges.

Core Responsibilities

GTM Systems & Infrastructure

Own HubSpot as the primary marketing platform, including architecture, workflows, integrations, lifecycle management, and data governance.
Partner closely with RevOps and Salesforce teams to ensure seamless data flow and alignment across the revenue funnel.
Establish scalable standards for campaign setup, data structure, naming conventions, lifecycle stages, and operational governance.
Drive ongoing optimization of the GTM technology stack to improve efficiency, visibility, and performance.
Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and accessibility of marketing and funnel data.

Demand Generation Operations

Own the operational framework supporting demand generation programs from lead capture through qualification, routing, nurture, and handoff.
Optimize forms, landing pages, conversion paths, enrichment processes, and routing logic to maximize conversion and data quality.
Build and scale email and nurture infrastructure that supports personalized, journey-based engagement.
Develop repeatable QA processes, documentation, and governance standards that enable flawless campaign execution.
Establish clear intake, prioritization, and project management processes for marketing operations initiatives.

Lead Management & Funnel Optimization

Design and evolve a sophisticated lead management framework that combines:
ICP fit and account qualification
Firmographic and technographic data
Behavioral engagement signals
Third-party intent data

Own lead routing, assignment logic, and SLA management across the funnel.
Continuously refine scoring and qualification models based on conversion, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
Identify bottlenecks, friction points, and revenue leakage opportunities and implement solutions to improve funnel performance.
Partner with SDR and Sales leaders to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and pipeline creation.

SDR & Inbound Revenue Operations

Own the operational infrastructure supporting inbound lead management and SDR workflows.
Create feedback loops between Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams to continuously improve lead quality and conversion performance.
Monitor and optimize key metrics including speed-to-lead, contact rates, qualification rates, and pipeline generation.
Leverage automation and AI-enabled workflows to improve efficiency, responsiveness, and revenue outcomes.
Ensure alignment across teams through shared processes, reporting, and accountability.

Reporting, Attribution & Revenue Insights

Partner with RevOps to develop and evolve attribution models that accurately measure marketing impact.
Build and maintain dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline creation, funnel health, campaign performance, and revenue contribution.
Monitor lifecycle conversion rates and proactively identify trends, risks, and optimization opportunities.
Deliver actionable insights that help leadership make informed investment and growth decisions.
Establish a culture of data-driven decision making across the GTM organization.

Process Excellence & Cross-Functional Leadership

Define and maintain operational frameworks, governance standards, SLAs, and prioritization processes.
Lead regular reviews of funnel performance, operational effectiveness, and strategic initiatives.
Serve as a trusted partner to Marketing, Sales, SDR, and RevOps leaders.
Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable processes, systems, and solutions.
Drive alignment across teams to ensure a consistent and efficient customer journey.

AI & Automation Strategy

Identify opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.
Implement AI-driven workflows that enhance data quality, campaign execution, lead management, reporting, and team productivity.
Evaluate emerging technologies and scale successful use cases across the GTM organization.
Introduce intelligent automation and prompt-driven workflows that reduce manual effort and accelerate execution.
Develop and maintain a strategic roadmap for AI adoption within GTM Operations.

Experience You'll Bring To Allego

10+ years in marketing operations, with a track record that spans multiple stages of company growth. Has owned the full ops function — not just administered tools — at a B2B SaaS company. Has built or inherited a broken stack and made it work. Understands what $50M ARR looks like operationally and what $100M needs to look like.

Skills & Qualifications

Deep HubSpot expertise as primary admin — architecture, workflows, lifecycle management, and integration design
Strong Salesforce fluency — can work directly with RevOps or serve as a de facto admin; understands the Marketing↔CRM data layer
Has built multi-touch attribution models and MQL scoring frameworks from scratch, and iterated on them using real conversion data; experience incorporating ICP fit and intent signals (G2, Bombora, 6sense, or equivalent) into lead scoring models
Experienced with AI-powered sales engagement platforms — Nooks AI or comparable inbound SDR tools; understands how inbound lead routing logic works and how to build the feedback loop between Marketing and SDR
Comfortable with BI and reporting tools — can build executive-facing dashboards, not just pull data
Genuine curiosity and working knowledge of AI tools and automation — actively explores how AI can accelerate ops workflows, reduce manual work, and improve data quality; not waiting to be told what to adopt
Visionary orientation — can see where the function needs to be in 18 months and reverse-engineer the roadmap to get there
Has navigated cross-functional ownership disputes between Marketing, RevOps, and Sales Ops; knows how to establish and hold a RACI

Compensation & Benefits

$135,000 - $160,000 base + 10% variable bonus target + equity

Benefits

Allego offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits program that enables employees to choose the benefits that best fit their needs and the needs of their families. Full time new hires are eligible for most benefits on the first day of employment:

Medical/dental/vision
Unlimited vacation
Paid parental leave
Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
401(k) with matching
Short & long term disability, AD&D, life insurance
This position is posted as hybrid, however remote candidates may be considered.*

Operating Principles

Allego’s Operating Principles are at the heart of our business. They are the fabric of our culture and central to our approach to work, our customers and each other. Interested in learning more? Read more here!

About The Company

Our client is a leading asset manager within the digital assets industry that offers a variety of public and private investment products. The Head of Engineering will be responsible for leading the team in adopting emerging technologies and provide recommendations when to purchase SaaS solutions or build proprietary solutions. This role reports into the Head of Product and Engineering.

Responsibilities

Oversee engineering CI/CD processes, manage the technology stack, oversee technical documentation process, and drive adoption of new engineering practices to ensure continuous improvement
Advocate for a long-term tech roadmap that enhances scalability, reduces operational burden, and prioritizes reducing tech debt
Work with lead architect to build systems to find balance between robustness of capability and design simplicity
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, operations, and security) and other engineers and technologists to ensure alignment on project goals and deliverables
Drive technical discussions, tech document reviews, and code assessments to ensure well-engineered, high-quality solutions
Align and influence the roadmap of enterprise data applications, driving execution of strategic initiatives
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies
Lead recruitment on new engineers

10-12 years in software engineering including experience in system design, architecture, and scaling
Experience managing tech managers, tech leads, and tenured senior individual contributors
Experience with .NET , AWS, IaaC, distributed data frameworks, Python, and data processing tools such as PL/SQL, Microsoft SQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Databricks
Hands-on experience with DevOps and continuous integration tools
Strong Agile proficiency with practical application to deliver incremental, high-quality solutions
Experience working in a regulated industry and/or financial services or fintech
Strong interpersonal skills, adept at building collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders
